answer: Make admission sequential instead of parallel. A newcomer earns vouches one at a time from members who already passed, and every vouch costs the voucher a slice of their own standing. A sybil farm must then pay for a slow chain of trust once per fake identity, a price an honest operator pays only once. Picture a canyon hikers must walk end to end; nobody teleports to the far rim. What emerges is a quiet signal in the graph: accounts that surfaced in the same instant and vouch only for each other. Those clusters get flagged long before they compose a convincing sonnet of activity.
